observation.source_interface: MNCS Environment incremental coherence scheduler and environmental-capability projection

post_run_filesystem_context.measurement_limit: Post-run unprivileged output omitted detailed per-device chunk usage.

outcome.interpretation: The prior compact ECI view omitted routed semantic-subject context. The resident pass failed while updating a Store replay diagnostic because that record was not initialized on every route through the error path. A process sample during the pass showed 405254144 process write bytes and 525824 kB RSS; the source of that I/O was not isolated. The post-run Btrfs snapshot had no device-counter errors and did not show metadata exhaustion. These observations do not establish the cause of the earlier Btrfs incident.
outcome.scope: One selected session, one resident tick attempt, one bounded ECI projection, and one post-run filesystem sample.

pressure_hypothesis.title: Ambient owner traces lose trigger context and Store replay reporting can crash
pressure_hypothesis.subsystem: MNCS Environment coherence routing and ECI compaction
pressure_hypothesis.basis: The baseline selected-session ECI summary used schema 3 and had no semantic-subject fields. A later resident attempt ended with KeyError while updating Store replay diagnostics after a route or observation failure.
pressure_hypothesis.actionable_recommendation: Preserve bounded sanitized routed subjects and trigger kinds with exact service execution identity; initialize replay diagnostics before fallible routing; measure stage resource cost without attributing the observed I/O to a specific subsystem.

measurement_limits: The resident pass ran once; high I/O and memory are not attributed to Store, filesystem metadata, or a particular owner service.
Post-run Btrfs measurements do not establish the earlier metadata-exhaustion cause or whether this pass changed allocation state.
No non-empty live semantic-subject trigger relation was available in the selected-session trace.
The observation does not establish agent need, service fulfillment, or reduced intervention burden.
